summary: 20 items collected in the past 24 hours, 10 picks (Leading agents 7, Model releases 3). Headline: v0.24.0.

items.title: v0.24.0
items.en_oneliner: The Agents SDK ships version 0.24.0, unifying run-wide function error formatting and adding MCP discovery annotations, while improving recovery, sandbox safety, and tracing.
items.reason: Official source · Covers release · Published within 6 hours

items.title: Introducing Gemini 4 Neon
items.en_oneliner: The newest member of the Gemini 4 family, built for fast end-to-end completion of complex coding, knowledge work, and science tasks — positioned between Carbon and Hydrogen to balance frontier capability with cost efficiency, now available in the Gemini API and AI Studio.
items.reason: Official source · Covers Gemini · Published within 6 hours

items.title: Gemini 4 Neon in GitHub Copilot
items.en_oneliner: GitHub Copilot now offers Google's latest Gemini 4 Neon for agentic coding, multistep tool calls and knowledge tasks.
items.reason: Official source · Covers Gemini and Agent · Published within 6 hours

items.title: Genie 4 is now available
items.en_oneliner: DeepMind's interactive world model Genie 4 is now open, turning text or image prompts into explorable worlds you can move through in real time.

items.title: DaisyRose-27B: Pushing the Frontier of Post-Training Efficiency
items.en_title: DaisyRose-27B: Pushing the Frontier of Post-Training Efficiency
items.en_oneliner: RadixArk's 27B-parameter DaisyRose explores getting stronger model performance from less post-training effort.

items.title: v0.25.0
items.en_oneliner: Agents SDK 0.25.0 opens up utilities for third-party session adapters, drops the Runloop sandbox provider, and adds opt-in handoff error recovery.

items.title: Release v0.28.0-nightly.20261118.d9ac287c9f
items.en_oneliner: Qwen Code ships a new nightly build improving scheduled-loop tests for managed agents and hardening PR verification guards and container logic.
items.reason: Official source · Covers Agent and release · Published within 6 hours

items.title: v2.70.0 (2026-11-17)
items.en_oneliner: Pydantic AI 2.70.0 fixes a high-severity security issue where stripping ANSI escapes in tool output limits could take quadratic time.

items.title: LangSmith for Coding Agents: Now track spend by outcome
items.en_title: LangSmith for Coding Agents: Now track spend by outcome
items.en_oneliner: LangSmith adds reporting for coding agents that ties their spending to the pull requests they ship, letting teams weigh the investment by actual results.

items.title: Research acceleration: The jagged frontier
items.en_oneliner: OpenAI ran hands-on tests to gauge how much coding agents speed up AI research, finding uneven gains across tasks, and discusses what that trend means for research accelerating itself.
